justification: Both depict a frontal, highly schematic human-like figure with an oversized elongated head set directly over a torso, with paired chest features and side arms/shoulder forms in roughly the same positions. The biggest difference is that A is covered with additional incised motifs, bands, circles, and internal designs across the head and body, while B presents a much plainer anthropomorphic figure dominated by a large modeled face with brow, nose, and ears.
